LESSON: THE FALL OF MAN

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.3: The Fall of Man

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on The Fall of Man. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it important to obey God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-11

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: THE FALL OF MAN
This lesson teaches The Fall of Man for Grade 5 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-11
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe The Fall of Man using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about The Fall of Man above.
2. Explain The Fall of Man to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand The Fall of Man.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Fall of Man with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is The Fall of Man important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to obey God?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-11

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
